texts:
Heat Check for Week 8: who is earning more of the ball and who is losing it, one number for each. Snaps, routes and targets, not box scores.

Biggest riser: Colston Loveland.
Biggest faller: Garrett Wilson.
Let's get into it.
#DaBears #JetUp

Colston Loveland, CHI TE: targets 5, 7, then 12, a 40 percent share vs NE, on 84 percent of the snaps. Cole Kmet's knee injury is season-ending.
TE4 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a WR2.
#DaBears

D'Andre Swift, CHI RB: snap share 58, 58, then 86 percent, and 22 carries for 78 and a TD with Kyle Monangai out a third game.
RB13 rest of season for me. Hold him; Monangai's return to practice is what would change it.
#DaBears

Tre Tucker, LV WR: targets 5, 7, then 12, on 82 percent of the snaps, 5 for 103 and a TD vs LAR. Last week's touchdowns now have volume under them.
WR55 for me, and the targets say higher. Claim him, 4 to 8 percent of FAAB.
#RaiderNation

KC Concepcion Jr., CLE WR: targets 1, 6, then 10, the most on the Browns, and 8 for 129 at TEN on 79 percent of the snaps.
WR40 rest of season for me. Add him, 3 to 6 percent of FAAB.
#DawgPound

Makai Lemon, PHI WR: snap share up from 70 percent in Week 3 to 91 Monday, and 7 of 8 for 67 and a TD with DeVonta Smith out.
WR47 for me. Add him, 2 to 5 percent of FAAB, before Smith's Wednesday practice report.
#FlyEaglesFly

Jordan Mason, MIN RB: 38 snaps to Aaron Jones Sr.'s 15 in his first game off IR, 15 carries for 68.
RB33 rest of season for me. Claim him, 10 to 20 percent of FAAB.

Jones aggravated the MCL. RB27 for me. Monitor Wednesday's Vikings injury report.
#Skol

Jonah Coleman, DEN RB: 30 snaps off IR, the most of any Denver back, and 9 for 54.
RB49 for me. Claim him, 5 to 10 percent of FAAB.

J.K. Dobbins, DEN RB: snap share 52, 52, then 23 percent.
RB36 for me. Drop him for Coleman.
#BroncosCountry

Ollie Gordon II, MIA RB: 25 carries for 103 and a TD at NYJ on 83 percent of the snaps, and Jaylen Wright left with a quad injury.
RB45 rest of season for me. Add him, 2 to 5 percent of FAAB.
#PhinsUp

Michael Penix Jr., ATL QB: 3 TD passes in each of his last two games and no interception in three, 25 of 34 vs SF. Atlanta plays at TB Sunday.
QB24 rest of season for me. Add him in superflex, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.
#DirtyBirds

Alvin Kamara, NO RB: snap share up from 26 to 56 percent, 7 catches on 7 targets vs PIT.
RB41 for me. Hold him through the bye.

Kendre Miller, NO RB: 20 carries, then 8 for 6 yards.
RB64 for me. Drop him for any add on the list.
#Saints

Elic Ayomanor, TEN WR: snap share 52, 61, then 89 percent, and 7 targets vs CLE after 2 in each of the two games before.
WR86 for me. Add him in deep leagues, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB.
#TitanUp

Ryan Flournoy, DAL WR: 78 percent of the snaps and 4 of 4 for 70 at PHI. He has out-targeted Jake Ferguson 13 to 4 over two games.
WR67 for me. Add him in deep leagues, 0 to 2 percent.

Ferguson: TE17 for me. Drop him for any tight end on the list.
#DallasCowboys

Now the fallers.

Garrett Wilson, NYJ WR: target share 38, 21, then 10 percent, 2 for 26 on 3 targets while Omar Cooper Jr. caught 5 for 115 and a TD.
WR13 rest of season for me. Monitor his targets vs LV Sunday.
#JetUp

Sam LaPorta, DET TE: 97 percent of the snaps vs GB and 2 targets, a 6 percent share, while Amon-Ra St. Brown drew 11.
TE6 rest of season for me. Monitor his targets vs MIN Sunday.
#OnePride

Isaiah Likely, NYG TE: 24 targets in Weeks 5 and 6, then 2 catches for 12 on 4 in J.J. McCarthy's first start. The Giants are on bye.
TE8 rest of season for me. Monitor his targets at PHI in Week 9.
#NYGiants

Germie Bernard, PIT WR: targets 9, 12, then 5, on 91 percent of the snaps, while Rico Dowdle drew 6 out of the backfield.
WR56 rest of season for me. Monitor his targets vs CLE Sunday.
#HereWeGo

Kyren Williams, LAR RB: snap share 73, 72, then 51 percent, and Blake Corum had 6 red zone carries.
RB10 for me. Monitor the split vs LAC Sunday.

Tyler Higbee, LAR TE: 3 targets at LV.
TE36 for me. Drop him for any tight end on the list.
#RamsHouse

Chuba Hubbard, CAR RB: 28 carries, then 7 in a 43-13 loss. The score did most of it.
RB21 for me. Monitor his carries at GB Thursday night.

Bryce Young, CAR QB: pulled in the fourth.
QB12 for me. Monitor Dave Canales' word on Thursday's starter.
#KeepPounding

TreVeyon Henderson, NE RB: a season-low 13 snaps at CHI, 3 carries, and New England wants Corey Kiner to get carries too.
RB28 rest of season for me. Trade him away; ask for a bench WR with a weekly role.
#NEPats

Mike Washington Jr., LV RB: snap share 35, then 26 percent, as Ashton Jeanty went back to 72. Last week's claim was on half the early downs, and that went back to Jeanty.
RB48 for me. Drop him for any add on the list.
#RaiderNation

Juwan Johnson, NO TE: 1 catch for 7 yards over two games, and the Saints are on bye.
TE13 for me. Drop him for any tight end on the list.
#Saints

Every riser and faller, with the number behind it, is on the site. Follow @FF_ChefHazy for the rest of the week's calls, and repost this for your league.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/heat.html?week=8
